Menu.Legend: Eclipse in the Land of Plenty

Hud.Title: Night at Noon
Hud.Tooltip: Eclipse in progress — click to open

Intro.Title: Night at Noon
Intro.Subtitle: Chariã, the Celestial Jaguar, swallows the Sun

App.Title: Eclipse — Night at Noon
App.ActiveHint: Ticks down by 1 every time a character spends Hope. At zero, or at sunset, the Eclipse ends.
App.Rules: Once per long rest, while it is still day, spend Fear to start an Eclipse. The countdown is twice the number of players in the scene. For each Fear spent, roll a d10 and add that trait; a repeated trait raises the countdown by +2.
App.UsedHint: An Eclipse already happened since the last long rest.
App.UsedWarning: By the rules the Eclipse happens once per long rest, and it was already used. Start anyway?
App.SpendFear: Deduct the Fear from the tracker
App.NoEclipse: The sky is clear. For now, no Eclipse covers the Land of Plenty.
App.NotesPlaceholder: E.g. the mists rise and sight beyond Close has disadvantage…
App.ImproviseHint: Click the traits to toggle them on or off (Improvising an Eclipse).
App.EndConfirm: End the Eclipse now and remove all of its traits?

dificuldade.name: Thick Shadow
dificuldade.text: Increase the Difficulty of all adversaries and environments by 1 while the Eclipse lasts.
dificuldade.auto: Active effect: Difficulty +1 on adversaries and environments

esperanca.name: Waning Hope
esperanca.text: Reduce the players' Hope Die to a d10.
esperanca.auto: Active effect: d10 Hope Die on characters

critico.name: Celestial Jaguar's Claws
critico.text: All creatures score a critical success on a 19 or 20 on attack rolls against characters.
critico.auto: Active effect: crit on 19–20 for adversaries

Effect.Name: Eclipse — Night at Noon
Effect.Duration: Until the Eclipse countdown ends or sunset.

Chat.Speaker: Chariã, the Celestial Jaguar
Chat.StartFlavor: The birds fall silent. A colossal shadow swallows the Sun, and the bonfire flames waver.
Chat.EndFlavor: A grey light returns and shows the damage. It will happen again — no one knows when.

Errors.GMOnly: Only the GM can control the Eclipse.
Errors.AlreadyActive: An Eclipse is already in progress.
Errors.NotEnoughFear: Not enough Fear: need {fear}, you have {cur}.

DarkenScene.Name: Darken the scene during the Eclipse
DarkenScene.Hint: Default for the “Darken the scene” box in the Eclipse window.

DarknessLevel.Name: Darkness level
DarknessLevel.Hint: Scene darkness during the Eclipse (restored at the end).

ApplyEffects.Name: Apply traits automatically
ApplyEffects.Hint: Creates an “Eclipse” active effect on affected adversaries, environments and characters, and removes it at the end.

AutoTick.Name: Automatic countdown from Hope
AutoTick.Hint: Ticks the countdown down whenever a character's Hope decreases.

SystemCountdown.Name: Show in the countdown tracker
SystemCountdown.Hint: Also shows the Eclipse countdown in the system countdown tracker. Off by default: the system countdown panel pushes the Fear tracker to the left on smaller screens. The Eclipse HUD already shows the countdown.

SoundStart.Name: Start sound
SoundStart.Hint: Optional: audio file played for everyone when the Eclipse starts.

SoundEnd.Name: End sound
SoundEnd.Hint: Optional: audio file played when the sun returns.

Intensity.Name: Screen effect
Intensity.Hint: Intensity of the pulsing border during the Eclipse (only for you).

Animations.Name: Start and end animations
Animations.Hint: Shows the “Night at Noon” and “The Sun Returns” cinematics.
